name: Detekta – A Metal Detecting App
description: Detekta is a field logging, mapping, and survey app for metal detectorists. Log targets and finds, record tracks, capture photos, and export your data — fully offline.

screenshots.label: Home page — survey dashboard with the Detekta banner and Demo Survey card
Home page — expanded survey details including site conditions and expected period
Map page — survey map showing targets, finds, and recorded tracks
Targets page — expanded target card showing a Roman coin with photo and action buttons
Finds Library — Search and Filter panel with survey, type, and date filters
Finds Library — expanded find card showing a Victorian penny with photo and details
Log New Target — form with description, VDI, depth, type, and GPS location
Map page — Tile Grid showing coverage tracking with shaded cells and recorded track
Settings — Edit Detectorist Profile with name, NCMD number, and detector model
Settings — Quick Target Buttons with configurable VDI ranges for each colour
